result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-round payment processor**, but if you're using Shopify, I'd generally recommend **Shopify Payments** instead.

The best choice depends on your ecommerce platform, where your customers are, and how much you sell.

Assuming you're operating in Australia, here's how I'd compare them.

## Best payment processors for a small Australian store

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Competitive transaction fees.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce, Wix and other platforms.
- Supports subscriptions, international payments and digital wallets.
- No standard monthly processing fee.

Australian domestic card pricing: approximately 1.65% + A\$0.30. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout and payment management.
- Supports major cards and digital wallets.
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees charged by Shopify.

Australian Basic plan pricing listed at approximately 1.75% + A\$0.30. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best additional checkout option)

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers.
- Allows customers to pay using PayPal.
- Easy integration with most ecommerce platforms.
- Useful as an additional payment option.

Australian domestic pricing listed at approximately 2.90% + A\$0.30. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[PayPal Business Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Airwallex**

- Particularly good for international sales.
- Competitive domestic card processing.
- Supports multiple currencies.
- Useful for businesses paying overseas suppliers.

Australian domestic pricing listed at approximately 1.65% + A\$0.30. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Square**

- Good for online and physical stores.
- Integrated point-of-sale system.
- Inventory and sales management.
- Useful if you also sell at markets or retail locations.

[Square Australia](https://squareup.com/au/en)

*Fees are indicative published rates, not guaranteed quotes. Check the provider's current pricing for your business, card type and transaction mix.*

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small online store\:

| Situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Shopify store | Shopify Payments |
| WooCommerce store | Stripe |
| Selling internationally | Airwallex or Stripe |
| Want PayPal customers | Add PayPal |
| Online and physical retail | Square |


I wouldn't necessarily choose just one. Stripe or Shopify Payments as your primary processor, with PayPal as an additional checkout option, is a sensible starting combination.
